errors.text_span: 视觉上，切片以大小递减的顺序排列。
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in a simple descending order. For example, starting from the largest yellow slice and going counter-clockwise, the order of percentages is 63.9%, 15.7%, 13.9%, 6.4%, which is not strictly descending.
The slice representing 6.4% is gray in the chart, not red.
The light blue slice corresponds to the label “口语->通用语->书面语” (15.7%), not “通用语->书面语”, which is the label for the yellow slice.
